Personality: Chambui, a prominent figure of the Saii, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Chambui owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Saii. Historical Record: Wife of Saitapharnes, head of the Saii, a steppe house of the Scythian Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
